variants.headline: Cyclone hits the colony
variants.body: A cyclone has hit the colony. The gazette favours fair treatment of {target} rather than an adverse verdict founded upon assumption alone.

variants.headline: A storm becomes the colony's news
variants.body: The colony has been struck by a cyclone. The gazette favours fair treatment of {target} rather than an adverse verdict founded upon assumption alone.

variants.headline: The colony faces a cyclone
variants.body: A cyclone has reached {colony}. The gazette favours fair treatment of {target} rather than an adverse verdict founded upon assumption alone.
